description: Packaging + config + typed settings + structured logging foundation. Converts requirements.txt to a pinned pyproject.toml, rewrites config.yml to the new region/model/vector shape, and adds components/agent/{settings.py,logging_config.py}. This is the base every later feature imports; it is a prerequisite for FEAT-002/003/004. Grounded in the existing config.yml (opensearch/foundation_model/embeddingSize keys removed) and design.md Settings/config.yml sections, with the six locked fixes applied where relevant (expected_dimension defaults to null, Locked Fix 3).
steps: Create <WT>/pyproject.toml (PEP 621, build-backend hatchling). [project] requires-python = '>=3.12,<3.14'. [project.dependencies] app group pinned (==) from the resolved env: streamlit, strands-agents (1.23.0), strands-agents-tools (0.2.19), boto3 (1.43.107), pillow, requests, pyyaml. [project.optional-dependencies]: infra = [aws-cdk-lib==2.150.0, constructs, cdk-nag], dev = [pytest, pytest-mock]. Add [tool.pytest.ini_options] with testpaths=['tests'].

Delete <WT>/requirements.txt and <WT>/components/layers/opensearch_layer/requirements.txt (the latter via deleting the whole components/layers tree is done in FEAT-002; here just remove the requirements.txt content dependency by deleting <WT>/requirements.txt).

Rewrite <WT>/config.yml to the design's new shape: stack_name: FashionAgentStack; primary_region: us-east-1; image_region: us-west-2; embedding_region: us-east-1; bucket_name: ''; models: {agent: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0, embeddings: amazon.nova-2-multimodal-embeddings-v1:0, text_to_image: stability.stable-image-core-v1:1, text_to_image_alt: stability.stable-image-ultra-v1:1, inpaint: us.stability.stable-image-inpaint-v1:0, outpaint: us.stability.stable-outpaint-v1:0}; inference_profile_fanout_regions: [us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2]; vector_index: {bucket_name: fashion-agent-vectors, index_name: images-index, expected_dimension: null (LOCKED FIX 3 - default null, not 1024), distance_metric: cosine, top_k: 3}. Remove schema_name, foundation_model, agent_name, embeddingSize, and the whole opensearch block.

Create <WT>/components/agent/settings.py: a frozen @dataclass Settings with fields primary_region, image_region, embedding_region, agent_model_id, embedding_model_id, text_to_image_model_id, text_to_image_alt_model_id, inpaint_model_id, outpaint_model_id, inference_profile_fanout_regions (tuple), expected_embedding_dimension (int | None), image_bucket, vector_bucket, vector_index, top_k, distance_metric. Add a module-local ConfigError(Exception). Add load_settings(config_path, variables_path) that merges config.yml defaults with variables.json CDK outputs (keys BucketName/VectorBucketName/VectorIndexName), allows env overrides FASHION_PRIMARY_REGION/FASHION_IMAGE_REGION/FASHION_EMBEDDING_REGION, validates presence of required model ids and variables.json keys (raise ConfigError when missing), and validates regions against a known-availability map (embedding_region must be a region where Nova 2 exists -> today us-east-1; image_region where stable-image-core/ultra exist -> us-west-2) raising ConfigError otherwise. Do NOT create any index here and do NOT call GetIndex here (that fatal check belongs to build_agent in FEAT-003, Locked Fix 2). No profile names anywhere (NFR-1).

Create <WT>/components/agent/logging_config.py: configure_logging(level='INFO') setting up stdlib logging with a structured formatter (timestamp, level, logger name, message); modules use logging.getLogger(__name__). Never log secrets.

Add <WT>/tests/__init__.py (empty) and a minimal <WT>/tests/test_settings.py asserting load_settings parses a fixture config+variables, honors the three env overrides, raises ConfigError on a missing variables.json key and on an impossible embedding_region/image_region, exposes expected_embedding_dimension=None when config has null, and that agent/inpaint/outpaint ids carry the 'us.' prefix while embeddings/text_to_image carry bare ids.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT> && pip install -e '.[infra,dev]' resolves without error (pyproject.toml is valid and pinned).

cd <WT> && python3 -c 'import components.agent.settings as s; cfg=s.load_settings(); print(cfg.primary_region, cfg.expected_embedding_dimension)' prints 'us-east-1 None' against the committed config.yml (with a test variables.json present or a fixture).
config.yml contains no schema_name/foundation_model/agent_name/embeddingSize/opensearch keys and expected_dimension is null.
verification: cd <WT> && python3 -c 'import components.agent.settings, components.agent.logging_config; print("import ok")'
findings:
Pinned versions (resolved and installed clean in a venv under Python 3.13.3): strands-agents==1.23.0, strands-agents-tools==0.2.19, boto3==1.43.107 (pulls botocore 1.43.108), aws-cdk-lib==2.150.0, cdk-nag==2.28.196 (installs as import name 'cdk_nag'), constructs 10.8.1, streamlit 1.65.0, pillow 11.3.0, pyyaml 6.0.3, requests 2.34.2, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-mock 3.16.0. Build backend hatchling; wheel packages=['components']; requires-python='>=3.12,<3.14'. pytest testpaths=['tests']. Install with: pip install -e '.[infra,dev]'.

Settings API (components/agent/settings.py):
- Frozen dataclass Settings fields: primary_region, image_region, embedding_region, agent_model_id, embedding_model_id, text_to_image_model_id, text_to_image_alt_model_id, inpaint_model_id, outpaint_model_id, inference_profile_fanout_regions (tuple[str,...]), expected_embedding_dimension (int|None), image_bucket, vector_bucket, vector_index, top_k (int), distance_metric (str).
- ConfigError(Exception) defined in this module (import: from components.agent.settings import ConfigError).
- load_settings(config_path=None, variables_path=None) -> Settings. Defaults resolve to <repo-root>/config.yml and <repo-root>/variables.json (root = parents[2] of settings.py).
- Env overrides: FASHION_PRIMARY_REGION / FASHION_IMAGE_REGION / FASHION_EMBEDDING_REGION (take precedence over config.yml).
- variables.json keys required (ConfigError if missing/empty): BucketName -> image_bucket, VectorBucketName -> vector_bucket, VectorIndexName -> vector_index. _flatten_outputs() accepts either flat outputs or the {StackName:{...}} nested shape from cdk --outputs-file.
- Region availability maps (frozensets): embedding_region must be in {us-east-1} (Nova 2); image_region must be in {us-west-2} (stable-image-core/ultra). ConfigError otherwise. Update these maps when AWS expands coverage.
- expected_embedding_dimension is None when config vector_index.expected_dimension is null (LOCKED FIX 3). No GetIndex/index creation here (belongs to build_agent, FEAT-003 / LOCKED FIX 2). No profile names (NFR-1).

config.yml new shape keys: stack_name, primary_region, image_region, embedding_region, bucket_name, models.{agent,embeddings,text_to_image,text_to_image_alt,inpaint,outpaint}, inference_profile_fanout_regions (list), vector_index.{bucket_name,index_name,expected_dimension(null),distance_metric,top_k}. Removed schema_name/foundation_model/agent_name/embeddingSize/opensearch.

Logging (components/agent/logging_config.py): configure_logging(level='INFO') is idempotent; format '%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s', datefmt ISO-8601. Modules use logging.getLogger(__name__).
